The '''Je'daii Temple Masters''' were the highest-ranking members of the [[Je'daii Order]]. They were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] who had excelled as [[Je'daii Master]]s and demonstrated true understanding of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Numbering nine at a given time, the Temple Masters acted as stewards of the [[Je'daii Temples|nine Great Temples]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and the leaders of the [[Je'daii Council]].

==Overview==
A rank within the [[Je'daii Order]], Temple Masters had attained the highest position within the Order and represented the wisest minds on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Making up the membership of the [[Je'daii Council]], the Temple Masters were each appointed as the leader of one of the [[Je'daii Temples|nine Great Temples of Tython]].<ref name="DOTJ0" />

==The Temple Masters (circa [[25,793 BBY]])==
*Master [[Ketu]] of [[Akar Kesh]]
*Master [[Quan-Jang]] of [[Anil Kesh]]
*Master [[Jake Fenn]] of [[Bodhi]]
*Masters [[Naro]] & [[Calleh]], Joint leaders of [[Mahara Kesh]]
*Master [[Kora Ryo]] of [[Kaleth]]
*Master [[Ruhr]] of [[Padawan Kesh]]
*Master [[Lha-Mi]] of [[Stav Kesh]]
*Master [[Miarta Sek]] of [[Qigong Kesh]]
*Master [[Tem Madog]] of [[Vur Tepe]]
